description.value: Twin City Brewing is Port Alberni's award-winning craft brewery and tasting room, pouring a rotating lineup of house-made ales, lagers, and sours alongside scratch-made hand-stretched pizza and smoked meat sandwiches. The brewery positions itself as part of Port Alberni's transformation into a tourism and recreation destination in the Alberni Valley on central Vancouver Island. With a full food menu, online ordering, and a loyalty program, it offers a comfortable sit-down stop for cyclists passing through the region.
